tools.name: tool_smith
tools.description: Call with no parameters (or only filters, e.g. read*) to list the saved functions of the library. Give run to execute a TypeScript function body in a child process and return one value, waiting up to block_ms; if it is still running you get an id and it keeps going: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it. Saved functions are reusable files called as fn.<name>(input) inside a run. The script runs with full interpreter privileges: the nested allow-list limits only the tools.* bridge, not what the script itself can do.

filters.description: With no run: only list functions whose name or description matches every filter, case-insensitive. A filter with * or ? is a wildcard pattern (read*, *file*); any other is a substring.

input.description: JSON data bound to the input variable.

block_ms.description: Most time to block for the result. If the script is still running an id is returned; collect it with the async tool.
